decisions.reason: Four years after launch with no visible market presence, the option no longer justifies continued resource commitment.
Similar to Product A, the resin injection unit has had enough time to show value and should be abandoned.
As a core automatic gun, keeping it supports the firm's spray application portfolio despite limited visibility.
Manual guns remain standard in the product range; the low cost of keeping justifies holding the option.
A product line with multiple models provides broader market coverage and lower cost per model, so keeping the option is still worthwhile.
The data logger has not demonstrated enough value to justify continued commitment, and resources are better used elsewhere.
